items.text: Access management for Azure resources is set to No.
Two break-glass accounts exist, both enabled, Member, Global Administrator, and in the Conditional Access exclude groups.

Per-user MFA does not allow app passwords, does not skip MFA for federated users on the intranet, offers notification through the mobile app and verification code from the mobile app or hardware token, and does not remember MFA on trusted devices.
No user can use preview features for My Apps, and no administrator can access My Staff.

Users cannot register applications or create security groups, non-admin users are restricted from creating tenants, access to the Microsoft Entra admin centre is restricted, and users cannot connect a work or school account with LinkedIn. Guest user access is restricted to properties and memberships of their own directory objects, and 'Keep user signed in' is shown.
Expiration is enabled for all Microsoft 365 groups, with a group lifetime of 180 days.

Owners cannot manage group membership requests in My Groups, user access to groups features in My Groups is not restricted, users cannot create security groups, and users can create Microsoft 365 groups.
The group naming policy has no block word list, no prefix, and no suffix configured.
All users may join devices to Microsoft Entra and register their devices, MFA is not required to register or join devices, and the maximum number of devices per user is unlimited.

Microsoft Entra Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS) is enabled, neither the Global Administrator role nor the registering user is added as local administrator on the device during Microsoft Entra join, and users are not restricted from recovering the BitLocker keys for their owned devices.
All users may sync settings and app data across devices.
Users are not restricted to seeing only Microsoft 365 apps in the Microsoft 365 portal.
Users cannot request admin consent to apps they are unable to consent to, and admin consent requests expire after 30 days, with selected users receiving email notifications and expiration reminders.
Users are not allowed to consent for applications to access the organization's data.
Password protection enforces a custom banned password list, locks out after 5 failed attempts for 60 seconds, is enabled on Windows Server Active Directory, and runs in Enforced mode.

Passkey (FIDO2) authentication is enabled for all users excluding the Conditional Access excluded identities, self-service set up is allowed, attestation and key restrictions are enforced, specific keys are restricted to an allow list, and the Microsoft Authenticator (Preview) key type is not checked.

Microsoft Authenticator is enabled for all users excluding the Conditional Access excluded identities, use of Microsoft Authenticator OTP is not allowed, number matching for push notifications is enabled for all users, and showing the application name, geographic location, and companion applications in notifications is Microsoft managed for all users.

Temporary Access Pass is enabled for all users excluding the Conditional Access excluded identities, with a minimum lifetime of 1 hour, a maximum lifetime of 8 hours, a default lifetime of 1 hour, one-time use off, and a pass length of 15 characters.
SMS, Hardware OATH tokens, Third-party software OATH tokens, Voice call, Email OTP, and Certificate-based authentication are all disabled as authentication methods.
The registration campaign for Microsoft Authenticator is enabled for all users, allows 14 days of snoozing with a limited number of snoozes, and excludes the Conditional Access excluded identities.
Reporting suspicious activity is Microsoft managed for all users, with reporting code 0.
System-preferred multifactor authentication is Microsoft managed for all users.
An authentication context for sensitive information exists, is published to apps, and has ID c1.

The 'Phishing-resistant MFA and TAP' authentication strength exists, combining Windows Hello for Business, Passkeys (FIDO2), and Certificate-based Authentication (Multifactor) as phishing-resistant MFA with Temporary Access Pass (one-time and multi-use) as multifactor authentication.
A named location 'Allowed Countries' lists the organisation's approved countries, determined by IP address, with unknown countries not included, and a 'Trusted IPs' location is marked as trusted.

The seven Microsoft built-in baseline Conditional Access policies are all Off: multifactor authentication for admins accessing Microsoft Admin Portals, for per-user multifactor authentication users, and for risky sign-ins with reauthentication; block legacy authentication; and require multifactor authentication for Azure management, for admins, and for all users.
Conditional Access policy 'USR - G - Agreement to terms of use' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and grants access when the terms of use are agreed to.

Conditional Access policy 'USR - B - Block access to sensitive information' exists, is On, applies to all users for the sensitive-information authentication context, blocks access, and excludes the sensitive-access group.

Conditional Access policy 'USR - B - Block access via legacy auth' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and blocks access from legacy authentication clients (Exchange ActiveSync and other clients).
Conditional Access policy 'USR - B - Block users with elevated insider risk' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and blocks access for users with elevated insider risk.

Conditional Access policy 'GST - B - Block guests' exists, is On, applies to B2B collaboration guest and member users, B2B direct connect users, local guest users, service provider users, and other external users for all resources, and blocks access, excluding the guest application user group.
Conditional Access policy 'USR - B - Block high-risk sign-ins' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and blocks access when sign-in risk is High.
Conditional Access policy 'USR - B - Block high-risk users' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and blocks access when user risk is High.

Conditional Access policy 'LOC - B - Block access from unapproved countries' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and blocks access from any network or location except the organisation's approved countries.

Conditional Access policy 'DEV - B - Block access from unapproved devices' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and blocks access from Android, Windows Phone, macOS, and Linux devices.
Conditional Access policy 'DEV - G - Compliant devices' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and grants access when the device is marked as compliant.

Conditional Access policy 'GST - G - Guest application access with strong auth' exists, is On, applies to B2B collaboration guest and member users, B2B direct connect users, local guest users, service provider users, and other external users for each guest-facing application, and grants access on phishing-resistant MFA.

Conditional Access policy 'DEV - G - Intune enrolment with strong auth' exists, is On, applies to all users for Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Intune Enrolment, and grants access on phishing-resistant MFA.

Conditional Access policy 'ADM - S - Limit admin sessions' exists, is On, applies to administrator roles and the administrative user group for all resources, and requires reauthentication every 4 hours.

Conditional Access policy 'USR - S - Limit user sessions' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, excludes administrator roles and the administrative user group, and requires reauthentication every 12 hours.

Conditional Access policy 'USR - G - Risky sign-ins with strong auth' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and grants access on phishing-resistant MFA when sign-in risk is Medium or Low.

Conditional Access policy 'USR - G - Register security info with strong auth' exists, is On, applies to all users registering security information, and grants access on phishing-resistant MFA and Temporary Access Pass.
Conditional Access policy 'USR - G - Require strong auth' exists, is On, applies to all users for all resources, and grants access on phishing-resistant MFA.
Multifactor authentication registration is required for all users excluding the Conditional Access excluded identities, and the policy is enforced.
On-premise password change is not allowed to reset user risk.
The sign-in risk policy requires multifactor authentication for all users excluding the break-glass accounts when sign-in risk is Medium or above, and the policy is enforced.
The user risk policy requires a password change for all users excluding the break-glass accounts when user risk is Medium or above, and the policy is enforced.
Self-service password reset requires 2 methods, from mobile app notification, mobile app code, and mobile phone; email, office phone, and security questions are not selected.
The password reset helpdesk link is not customised, and no custom helpdesk email or URL is set.
Users are notified on password resets, and all admins are notified when other admins reset their password.
Self-service password reset is enabled for the all-organisation-users group.
Users are required to register when signing in, and are asked to re-confirm their authentication information every 180 days.
Account lockout triggers after 3 multifactor authentication denials, the lockout counter resets after 300 minutes, and the account is automatically unblocked after 1440 minutes.
Users may submit fraud alerts, users who report fraud are automatically blocked, and the code to report fraud during the initial greeting is 0.
The default one-time bypass is 300 seconds.
Group owners cannot create and manage access reviews for groups they own.
External users are blocked from signing in to this directory and removed after 30 days.
Microsoft Entra ID, email one-time passcode, and Microsoft are configured as identity providers, and email one-time passcode for guests is not enabled.

Guest user access is restricted to properties and memberships of their own directory objects, no one in the organisation can invite guest users including admins, guest self-service sign up via user flows is off, external users may remove themselves from the organisation, and invitations may be sent to any domain.

Cross-tenant access is all blocked for B2B collaboration and B2B direct connect, inbound and outbound, with trusted settings disabled; tenant restrictions block all external users, groups, and applications; and the Microsoft cloud settings for Azure Government and Azure China are not checked.
